title: A Wrinkle in Time
description:
Small’s Novels & Nibbles brings you a humorous and bittersweet novel about Arjun Chatterjee, an optimistic Indian American entrepreneur who runs Bollywood Eggrolls, a food-truck outside a courthouse near Washington, D.C. As Arjun pursues business success and a romance with his regular customer Candy, he and an eccentric group of food-truck owners, musicians, and aspiring entrepreneurs struggle with financial uncertainty, competition, relationships, and failure. Through their efforts to keep chasing their dreams, this novel explores creativity, immigration, identity, love, resilience, and what it means to find freedom and success on one’s own terms.

Deep Fried Chicken Tikka Masala Egg Rolls, these crespy golden fried eggrolls bring together two culinary traditions in one delicious bite. Each is filled with house-made chicken tikka masala and fragrant basmati rice, topped with fresh cilantro, and served with cool cucumber, red onion, cilantro and spiced raita for dipping.

They’re crispy, savory, delightfully different, and completely crave-worthy. Stop by and give ‘em a try!
